theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Consumer Discretionary (+1.13%) and Technology (+0.74%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-0.05%) and Health Care (+0.06%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.74%, defensives +0.13%, and value/cyclicals +0.37% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.73%, Dow +0.49%, Nasdaq +1.19% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.94%. The VIX fell 6.53% to 15.31, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.79% to $4,172.10, crude oil was little changed at $91.26, and bitcoin slipped 0.01% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
